game.name: F.e.a.r. (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Ko,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: F.E.A.R is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. You are part of the First Encounter Assault Recon unit, which will plunge you into a horrific and terrible mission. The atmosphere of the game is creepy and scary as hell, especially as monsters and enemies swarm in. The multiplayer can accommodate 16 players for 8 different challenges including Deathmatch (solo or team), CDD (normal or slowed down) or Elimination.
